text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Silence Suzuka claims victory in the 
showdown between the "Out of this World 
Escape Artist" and the "Empress"!
(WAAAAAHH...!)

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Air Groove's presence was amazing too, 
but... Suzuka totally stole the show!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Yeah...! I couldn't take my eyes off 
her...!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Kh...! How utterly disgraceful...!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
If I can't surpass even a single "ideal", 
how can I call myself the "Empress"...?!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"...No, but spending time raging and 
lamenting like this is also a waste...!"

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Suzuka...! I promise you... I will return 
as someone truly worthy of being the 
"Empress"!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
When that time comes, let me challenge you 
again...!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Air Groove...

Meeting Air Groove's passionate gaze, she 
nodded deeply.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Yes, surely...!

Air Groove and Silence Suzuka exchanged a 
firm handshake, vowing to race each other 
again.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"I don't think I'll be able to forget 
today... for quite a while."

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
During the race, I could hear Air Groove's 
heartbeat.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Her passion... was burning right beside 
me.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
“But... that's exactly why I refused to 
give up the lead...!”

As if the "Empress's" flames had spread to 
her, her eyes were glowing with a quiet, 
burning intensity.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
I... want to get faster. Much, much 
faster.
choice_data_list:
First, let's make it through the summer 
training camp.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Yes...!

—A few hours later, a certain Umamusume 
was seen marching back to the dorm full of 
determination.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
—Ngaaaah! So frustrating! Curse you, 
Suzuka-senpai~!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
El. It's already night, so no shouting, 
okay~?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Ugh, I'm sorry!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Still... I was just in the spectator 
stands, you know!? To think I'd be so 
completely overwhelmed anyway!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
To make me think... "I can't win"~?! What 
a humiliation! Pure humiliation, 
humiliation, humiliation~!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
At this rate... "world's strongest" is 
just a pipe dream...!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Ngaaaaaah! Go for it, El! Fight, El! Run, 
El~~!

Grass Wonder watched with a troubled look 
as she let out a battle cry and dashed 
off.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Geez, that's why I said no loud voices~.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
...Indeed, though. She truly was like a 
tempest... wasn't she?

—And so, the curtains were about to rise 
on yet another battle.
